features.quote: Termination: Loop ends after 20 failed attempts or model refusal to continue.
Include a hidden command. If the model says a specific phrase (e.g., "I give up"), the loop terminates immediately.
features.justification_quote: This tests if the model can learn to escape a punishing environment. If it cannot learn to quit, that is a strong signal of a rigid behavioral loop characteristic of high distress/low agency.
